route: Close every menu with the bare spot (310,660); (400,640) is NOT safe after a camera shift (it selected a Barracks, which hides the left column, measured 2026-11-23 at 15:2xZ): WORLD then BASE first; WORLD (660,940) then BASE at the same place; never WORLD with a menu open low (the green Upgrade arrow can sit there); one building per fresh frame
Fresh frame taps: Lv.27 (462,585), Lv.30 (530,637), Lv.24 (628,562), Lv.20 (668,535); the pistol is the middle button under the tag
Tent E about (678,510); a portrait bubble over a barracks may be the Hospital, not a batch; tag may read Lv.20 or Lv.25

Four parade fields, tap a soldier in the middle: Lv.26 (705,690), Lv.28 (580,800), Lv.30 (770,940), Lv.27 (975,845) off-screen right; pan with a drag from (540,700) to (290,450), fresh is the panned frame plus (250,250) give or take 60 px
The flask icon; with both labs busy it opens only the Research Queue list

The running node's icon in the bottom bar at (456,925), NEVER the fast-forward button at (603,925); top gold node MAX (Unlock Oil Well), second row Food, Iron and Coin Output V, below them a locked node (Oil Output I probable), Fast Builder V and Research Enhancement V grey; read the FINISH NOW clock, not the blue Research button (about 11 percent longer); divisor 3.678 [M]

Bottom bar Inventory; the Resources tab opens with the 5,000 Diamonds x16 tile SELECTED and a live Use: tap the intended tile, confirm its name, never Use otherwise; a grid drag must start inside the grid; the number field opens no keypad, use the slider handle
The Alliance shield (ground it fresh), Techs, War tab
HEROES button, the list; if two taps fail try a class tab or another card, then stop
